The molecule is a tertiary amine. It has a role as an anti-ulcer drug, a H1-receptor antagonist and an anti-allergic agent. It is a conjugate base of a tertiary amine(1+).

The molecule is a morphinane alkaloid that is morphinone in which the enone double bond has been reduced to a single bond, the hydrogen at position 14 has been replaced by a hydroxy group, and the methyl group attached to the nitrogen has been replaced by an allyl group. A specific opioid antagonist, it is used (commonly as its hydrochloride salt) to reverse the effects of opioids, both following their use of opioids during surgery and in cases of known or suspected opioid overdose. It has a role as a mu-opioid receptor antagonist, a central nervous system depressant and an antidote to opioid poisoning. It is an organic heteropentacyclic compound, a morphinane alkaloid and a tertiary alcohol. It is a conjugate base of a naloxone(1+). It derives from a hydride of a morphinan.
The molecule is a fatty acid-taurine conjugate derived from elaidic acid. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It derives from an elaidic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a N-elaidate.

The molecule is a carbamate ester that is the isopropyl ester of 3-(diethylamino)propylcarbamic acid. A fungicide, it is used as a preservative and sapstain control chemical in wood products and as a preservative in adhesives, paints, latex paper coating, plastic, water-based inks, latex paper coating, plastic, water-based inks, metal working fluid and numerous consumer products. It has a role as an antifungal agrochemical. It is a carbamate ester, a tertiary amino compound and an isopropyl ester. It derives from a 3-(diethylamino)propylcarbamic acid.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide that is used (as its tosylate monohydrate) for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism. It has a role as an anticoagulant, an EC 3.4.21.6 (coagulation factor Xa) inhibitor and a platelet aggregation inhibitor. It is a monocarboxylic acid amide, a thiazolidinemonocarboxylic acid, a thioester and a tertiary amino compound. It is a conjugate base of an esomeprazole(1+).

The molecule is a pyrrolopyrazine that is hexahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazine-1,4-dione substituted by a piperidin-3-yl group at position 6 and a methyl group at position 3. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a pyrrolopyrazine, a N-arylpiperidine, a N-alkylpiperazine and a pyrrolopyrazine.

The molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound and tetramic acid derivative originally isolated from an unidentified oligosporic actinomycete strain (no. E864-861) and found to be active against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative anaerobic bacteria as well as some aerobic bacteria such as Streptococci. The methyl ester of nocamycin E. It has a role as an antibacterial agent and a bacterial metabolite. It is a spiroketal, a methyl ester, a gamma-lactam, an organic heterotricyclic compound, an olefinic compound, an enol and a member of tetramic acids. It derives from a nocamycin E. It is a conjugate acid of a nocamycin I(1-).

The molecule is an organic heterotetracyclic compound that is naloxone substituted in which the allyl group attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a methyl group. A mu-opioid receptor antagonist, it is used to treat alcohol dependence. It has a role as a mu-opioid receptor antagonist, a central nervous system depressant, an environmental contaminant, a xenobiotic and an antidote to opioid poisoning. It is an organic heterotetracyclic compound, a morphinane-like compound and a member of cyclopropanes. It is a conjugate base of a naltrexone(1+).

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 7-fluoro-3-[(2-trifluoromethyl)sulfanyl]oxolane-5-carboxylic acid with the amino group of ethylamine. It is a monocarboxylic acid amide, an organofluorine compound, a member of oxolanes and a member of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes.

The molecule is an acridin-9-ol that is 1,2-dihydrofuro[2,3-c]acridin-9-ol substituted by isopropyl, 5-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidin-4-yl and amino groups at positions 1, 6 and 8 respectively. A vasodilator agent, it inhibits the formation of blood clots. It has a role as an adenosine phosphodiesterase inhibitor, an EC 3.5.4.4 (adenosine deaminase) inhibitor, a platelet aggregation inhibitor and a vasodilator agent. It is a member of acridines and an acridin-9-ol.

The molecule is a gamma-amino acid that is gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) carrying an isobutyl substitutent at the beta-position (the S-enantiomer). Binds with high affinity to the alpha2-delta site (an auxiliary subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels) in central nervous system tissues. It has a role as an anticonvulsant and a calcium channel blocker. It derives from a gamma-aminobutyric acid.
The molecule is a polyether that is the dimethyl ether derivative of diethylene glycol. It has a role as a solvent, a xenobiotic and an environmental contaminant. It derives from a diethylene glycol.

The molecule is a hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous saxagliptin. Used for the treatment of Type II diabetes. It has a role as a hypoglycemic agent and an EC 3.4.14.5 (dipeptidyl-peptidase IV) inhibitor. It contains a saxagliptin.

The molecule is a member of the class of tetrahydrothiophenes that is tetrahydrothiophene in which the hydrogens attached to the nitrogens are replaced by methyl groups. The active metabolite of the dietary carcinogen tetrahydrothiophene. It has a role as a carcinogenic agent, a mutagen, a genotoxin, a human xenobiotic metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a member of tetrahydrothiophenes and a tertiary amino compound. It derives from a hydride of a tetrahydrothiophene.

The molecule is an N-glycosyl compound that is a metabolite produced by the bacterium Mycoplasma genitalium. It has a role as a Mycoplasma genitalium metabolite. It is a N-glycosyl compound, an azabicycloalkane, an aminopyrimidine and a pyrimidone.

The molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound that is 1,3,4,9,10,10a-hexahydro-2H-10,4a-(epiminoethano)phenothiazine substituted by a 3-(tert-butylamino)-2-hydroxypropyl group at position 6 and a methyl group at position 4a. It is a dual 5-HT3 and 5-HT4 receptors antagonist whose clinical development was terminated in phase II. It was being developed by Eisai (Tokyo, Japan) for the treatment of newly diagnosed malignant glioblastoma multiforme (concomitantly with radiotherapy) and malignant melanoma. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, a marine metabolite and a serotonergic antagonist. It is a member of phenols, an organic heterotricyclic compound, a secondary amino compound, a tertiary amino compound and an aromatic amine.
The molecule is a sulfone resulting from the oxidation of the sulfur atom of dibenzothiophene. It is a member of dibenzothiophenes and a sulfone. It derives from a dibenzothiophene.

The molecule is a member of the class of imidazoles that is 2-aminomethyl-2-imidazole in which the exocyclic amino hydrogens are replaced by morpholin-4-yl groups. An antibacterial formerly used oraly but withdrawn due to toxicity, it is used topically (as the hydrochloride salt) for treatment of ear disorders. It has a role as an antibacterial drug. It is a member of morpholines, a member of benzenes, an imidazole antifungal drug and a tertiary amino compound. It is a conjugate base of a thiomorpholine(1+).

The molecule is a member of the class of piperazines that is piperazine in which one of the nitrogens is substituted with a formyl group, while the other is substituted with a 3-fluoro-4-oxobutyl group. An antispermatogenic agent. It has a role as an antispermatogenic agent. It is a member of piperazines, a member of formamides, a tertiary carboxamide and an organofluorine compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolopyridines that is pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyridine which is substituted by a 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl group at position 2 and by a (2-cyclopropyl-7-methoxy-4-oxopyrrolidin-1(2H)-yl)ethyl group at position 5. It is a member of oxolanes, a member of pyrrolidines, a tertiary amino compound, a monocarboxylic acid amide and a member of cyclopropanes.

The molecule is a triazolopyrazine that is a rigid cyclohexylamine analogue of sitagliptin. It has a role as an EC 3.4.* (hydrolases acting on peptide bond) inhibitor. It is a triazolopyrazine and an organofluorine compound. It derives from a sitagliptin.

The molecule is a member of the class of chromanes that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-chromene substituted by a 2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-yl group at position 2, a hydroxy group at position 3, a methyl and a 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl group at position 5. Isolated from in Myrsine seguinii, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity. It has a role as a metabolite, an anti-inflammatory agent and an EC 4.4.1.11 (methionine gamma-lyase) inhibitor. It is a member of chromanes, a member of phenols and a primary amino compound.

The molecule is a maleate salt obtained by reaction of 2-[(1E)-cyclohexyl-3-(dimethylamino)propyl](methyl)aminotetralin-7-ol with one equivalent of maleic acid. This ligand has uniquely high affinity and selectivity for the D3 receptor. It has a role as a dopamine agonist. It contains a 2-[(1E)-cyclohexyl-3-(dimethylamino)propyl](methyl)aminotetralin-7-ol(1+).

The molecule is a pyridazinone that is pyridazin-3(2H)-one substituted by an amino group at position 5, a chloro group at position 4 and a methyl group at position 2. It has a role as an environmental contaminant, a xenobiotic and a herbicide. It is a pyridazinone, an organochlorine compound, a primary amino compound and a member of guanidines.

The molecule is a (13)N-modified compound that is sodium iodide in which the nitrogen has been replaced by an iodine atom. (13)N decays with a half-life of ten minutes to (13)C, emitting a positron. Used in diagnostic Positron Emission Tomography (PET) imaging. It has a role as a radioactive imaging agent.

The molecule is the L-valinyl ester of ganciclovir, into which it is rapidly converted by intestinal and hepatic esterases. It is a synthetic analogue of 2'-deoxyguanosine. It has a role as a prodrug and an antiviral drug. It is a member of purines and a L-valyl ester. It derives from a guanine and a ganciclovir.
The molecule is an organofluorine compound, a thiol and a monocarboxylic acid. It has a role as an anticoronaviral agent. It derives from an adenosine.

The molecule is a synthetic ergot alkaloid, structurally related to the oxytocic agent methylergonovine and to the potent hallucinogen LSD and used prophylactically to reduce the frequency and intensity of severe vascular headaches. It has a role as a sympatholytic agent, a vasoconstrictor agent and a serotonergic antagonist. It is an ergot alkaloid and a monocarboxylic acid amide. It derives from a hydride of an ergoline.

The molecule is a dicarboxylic acid monoamide that is the N-(isopropyl) derivative of 4,5-dibromo-2,5-dihydrofuran-3-carboxylic acid. One of the most potent and toxic of the long-acting local anesthetics, its parenteral use was restricted to spinal anesthesia. It is now generally only used (usually as the hydrochloride) in creams and ointments and in a variety of vegetable and fruit crops. It has a role as a herbicide, an agrochemical and an EC 6.4.1.2 (acetyl-CoA carboxylase) inhibitor. It is a dicarboxylic acid monoamide, a cyclic ketone, a member of phenols and an organobromine compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of quinolines that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline which is substituted at positions 2, 6, and 7 by methyl, oxo, and fluorine, respectively. A fungicide used to control a range of pathogens including Tapesia yallundae, Botrytis spp., Alternaria spp. and Rhynchospium secalis. It has a role as an antifungal agrochemical. It is a member of quinolines, an organofluorine compound and an oxacycle.

The molecule is a cyclooctadepsipeptide that is isolated from Papua New Guinea collections of the marine sponges Theonella mirabilis and Theonella swinhoei. It exhbits anti-HIV-1 activity and cytotoxicity against some human cancer cell lines. It has a role as an anti-HIV-1 agent, a marine metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a cyclooctadepsipeptide, an olefinic compound, a secondary alcohol and a tertiary alcohol.

The molecule is a member of the class of pterocarpans that is (6aS,11aS)-6a,11a-dihydro-6H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-c]chromene which is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 3, a second methyl group at position 6a (resulting in the CIP stereochemical designation changing to R,R), and a methylenedioxy group at positions 8-9. It is a metabolite of the pea phytoalexin (+)-pisatin, produced by the pea-pathogenic Fusarium oxysporum forma specialis pisi, and a number of other fungi, including Fusarium anruioides, Fusarium avenaceum, Mycosphaerella pinodes, and Stemphylium botryosum. It is a member of pterocarpans and a secondary amino compound. It derives from a (+)-maackiain.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolopyridines that is pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyridine which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 6 by ethyl, 2-fluorophenyl, and 4-amino-5-cyclohexylnitrilo groups, respectively. It is an antifungal drug used for the treatment of mucosal candidiasis and for systemic infections including systemic candidiasis, chromoblastomycosis, and sporotrichosis. It has a role as a P450 inhibitor, an environmental contaminant and a xenobiotic. It is a pyrrolopyridine, a member of monofluorobenzenes, an aminopyridine, a tertiary amino compound, a primary amino compound and a nitrile.

The molecule is an aryl dialkyl phosphate where both the alkyl groups are ethyl and the aryl group is 4-nitrophenyl. It has a role as an EC 3.1.1.7 (acetylcholinesterase) inhibitor and a mouse metabolite. It is an aryl dialkyl phosphate and an organophosphate insecticide.

The molecule is a member of the class of piperidines that is donepezil in which the 5-methoxy group has been demethylated to the corresponding hydroxy derivative. It is metabolite of donepezil, a drug used in the treatment of dementia. It has a role as a drug metabolite. It is a member of piperidines, a cyclic ketone, an aromatic ether and a member of guaiacols.

The molecule is an epoxide that is 1,2-epoxypropene in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by chlorine. It is an organochlorine compound and an epoxide. It derives from a 1,2-epoxypropane.

The molecule is the (S)-enantiomer of tetrahydro-4H-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazine-1,4-dione. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a (S)-tetrahydro-4H-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazine-1,4-dione(1-). It is an enantiomer of a (R)-tetrahydro-4H-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazine-1,4-dione.

The molecule is a the S-enantiomer of tetrahydrofolic acid. It has a role as an Escherichia coli metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a conjugate acid of a (S)-tetrahydrofolate(1-). It is an enantiomer of a (R)-tetrahydrofolic acid.

The molecule is an amino cyclitol glycoside that is kanamycin A acylated at the N-1 position by a 4-amino-2-hydroxybutyryl group. It has a role as an antimicrobial agent, an antibacterial drug and a nephrotoxin. It is an alpha-D-glucoside, an aminoglycoside, a carboxamide and an amino cyclitol glycoside. It derives from a kanamycin A. It is a conjugate base of an amikacin(4+).

The molecule is an azamacrocycle which is used which is in combination with dasabuvir sodium hydrate, ombitasvir and ritonavir (under the trade name Viekira Pak) for treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1 infection as well as cirrhosis of the liver. It has a role as an antiviral drug and a hepatitis C protease inhibitor. It is an azamacrocycle, a member of pyrazines, an aromatic amine, an olefinic compound, a N-alkylpiperazine, a primary amino compound and a bridged compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine which is substituted by a 2-(1-methylpiperidin-4-yl)ethyl group at position 2. It is a member of phenothiazines, a N-alkylpiperazine and a member of piperidines. It derives from a hydride of a 10H-phenothiazine.

The molecule is an N-acyl-L-alpha-amino acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-(isopropyloxy)-4-isobutyric acid with the amino group of L-valine. It is a N-acyl-L-alpha-amino acid, a member of pyrrolidines and a tertiary amino compound. It derives from a 4-(isopropyloxy)-4-isobutyric acid.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is an mTOR inhibitor and shows anti-tumour properties. It has a role as a mTOR inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of morpholines, a pyridopyrimidine, a monomethoxybenzene, a tertiary amino compound and a member of benzyl alcohols.
The molecule is a sulfonamide consisting of butanoic acid with a 4-(trimethylsulfonyl)butyl group at its 4-position. It has a role as a hapten. It is a sulfonamide and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-fluoro-N-2-[(2-fluoro-4-methoxypyridin-2-yl)methyl]phenyl-1-methoxycyclohexanecarboxylic acid with the amino group of morpholine. It is an inhibitor of leucine-rich repeat kinase 2 (LRRK2). It has a role as an EC 2.7.11.1 (non-specific serine/threonine protein kinase) inhibitor. It is an aminopyridine, a member of morpholines, a monocarboxylic acid amide, an organofluorine compound, a tertiary amino compound and an aromatic ether.

The molecule is a hydrochloride obtained by combining equimolar amounts of naloxone and hydrogen chloride. A specific opioid antagonist, it is used to reverse the effects of opioids, both following their use of opioids during surgery and in cases of known or suspected opioid overdose. It has a role as an antidote to opioid poisoning, a mu-opioid receptor antagonist and a central nervous system depressant. It contains a naloxone(1+).

The molecule is the simplest member of the class of propane-1,2-diols, consisting of propane in which a hydrogen at position 1 and a hydrogen at position 2 are substituted by hydroxy groups. A colourless, viscous, hygroscopic, low-melting (-59°C) and high-boiling (188°C) liquid with low toxicity, it is used as a solvent, emulsifying agent, and antifreeze. It has a role as a protic solvent, an allergen, a human xenobiotic metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a member of propane-1,2-diols and a glycol.

The molecule is a thienopyridine that is ticlopidine which carries a chloro group at position 7. It is a metabolite of the antiplatelet drug, ticlopidine. It has a role as a drug metabolite. It is a thienopyridine, a member of monochlorobenzenes, a tertiary amino compound and an organochlorine compound. It derives from a ticlopidine.
The molecule is a pyrimidone that is uracil in which positions 1, 5, and 6 are substituted by ethoxymethyl, isopropyl, and cyclohexyl groups, respectively. It derives from a uracil.

The molecule is a member of the class of oxolanes that is oxolane (tetrahydrofuran) substituted by a 2,4-dichlorophenyl group at position 2 and a 1-phenylprop-1-en-1-yl group at position 5. It is a member of oxolanes, a dichlorobenzene and an ether. It derives from a hydride of an oxolane.

The molecule is a tertiary amino compound that is piperazine in which the hydrogens attached to nitrogen are replaced by a (4-cyanopyridin-3-yl)methyl group, while the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen are replaced by a methyl group and a 6-[4-(trifluoromethyl)piperazin-1-yl]methylpyrimidin-4-yl group. It is a member of pyrimidines, a tertiary amino compound, an organofluorine compound and a member of pyridines.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide that is lysergamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amide nitrogen is substituted by a 1-hydroxypropan-2-yl group (S-configuration). An ergot alkaloid that has a particularly powerful action on the uterus, its maleate (and formerly tartrate) salt is used in the active management of the third stage of labour, and to prevent or treat postpartum of postabortal haemorrhage caused by uterine atony: by maintaining uterine contraction and tone, blood vessels in the uterine wall are compressed and blood flow reduced. It has a role as an oxytocic, a diagnostic agent, a toxin and a fungal metabolite. It is an ergot alkaloid, a monocarboxylic acid amide, a primary alcohol, a tertiary amino compound, an organic heterotetracyclic compound and a secondary amino compound. It derives from a hydride of an ergoline.

The molecule is an epoxy steroid that is 3,17beta-dihydroxy-5alpha-androst-2-ene-2-carbonitrile in which the oxygen of the epoxy group is joined to the 4alpha and 5 alpha positions. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an abortifacient and an EC 1.1.1.210 [3beta(or 20alpha)-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase] inhibitor. It is a 3-hydroxy steroid, a 17beta-hydroxy steroid, an androstanoid, an epoxy steroid and a nitrile.

The molecule is a fourth-generation cephalosporin antibiotic having (4-carbamoyl-1-azoniabicyclo[2.2.2]octan-1-yl)methyl and [(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]amino side groups located at positions 3 and 7 respectively. It is a cephalosporin and a member of thiadiazoles.

The molecule is a third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic with a [(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-4-carboxybut-2-enoyl]amino substituent at the 7 position of the cephem skeleton. An orally-administered agent, ceftibuten is used as the dihydrate to treat urinary-tract and respiratory-tract infections. It has a role as an antibacterial drug. It is a cephalosporin and a dicarboxylic acid.

The molecule is a member of the class of chromanes that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-chromene substituted by a 2-(diethylamino)ethoxy group at position 2. It is isolated from the radix of Caulophyllum robustum and exhibits anti-myocardial ischemia activity. It has a role as a metabolite and a cardiovascular drug. It is a member of chromanes, an ether and a secondary amino compound.

The molecule is a p-menthane monoterpenoid that consists of cyclohex-2-enone having methyl and isopropenyl substituents at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It has a role as an allergen. It is a member of carvones and a botanical anti-fungal agent.

The molecule is an N-alkylpiperazine that is N,N-dimethyl-N'-trans-4-[2-(piperidin-1-yl)ethyl]cyclohexylurea substituted at position 4 on the piperazine ring by a 2,3-dimethylbutyl group. Used (as the hydrochloride salt) for treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It has a role as a dopamine agonist, a second generation antipsychotic and a serotonergic antagonist. It is a member of ureas, a N-alkylpiperazine, a N-arylpiperazine and a tertiary amino compound. It is a conjugate base of a cariprazine(1+).

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S,4R)-4,5-dihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)piperidine-3-carboxylic acid (tabtoxinine-delta-lactam) with the amino group of (2S,4R)-[(2S,4R)-2-amino-2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylidenecyclohexan-2-yl]-L-alanine. Used (in the form of its hydrochloride salt trihydrate) in combination with fluorouracil and leucovorin, for the treatment of patients with metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas after disease progression following gemcitabine-based therapy. It is converted via hydrolysis of the carbamate linkage to its active metabolite, SN-38, which is 1000 times more active. It has a role as an EC 5.99.1.2 (DNA topoisomerase) inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent, an apoptosis inducer, a prodrug, an EC 5.99.1.3 [DNA topoisomerase (ATP-hydrolysing)] inhibitor and a prodrug. It is a monocarboxylic acid amide, a member of piperidines, a delta-lactam and a member of phenols. It derives from a tabtoxinine-delta-lactam.
The molecule is a methyl-L-leucine that has L-configuration. It is a methyl-L-leucine and a N-methyl-L-alpha-amino acid. It is an enantiomer of a N-methyl-D-leucine.

The molecule is a member of the class of piperidines that is N-propylpiperidine in which the methyl hydrogens have been replaced by hydroxy, phenyl, and 5-norbornen-2-yl groups. A muscarinic antagonist affecting both the central and peripheral nervous systems, it is used in the treatment of all forms of Parkinson's disease. It has a role as a muscarinic antagonist, a parasympatholytic, an antiparkinson drug, an antidyskinesia agent and an antidote to sarin poisoning. It is a member of piperidines, a tertiary amino compound and a tertiary alcohol.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide that is N-(2,6-dimethylmorpholin-4-yl)-2-[2-(2-hydroxyethyl)ethyl]aniline in which the nitrogen of the morpholine moiety has been converted to the corresponding 2-hydroxyethyl amide. It is an inhibitor of the signalling G-protein known as RAC1 (Ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1). It has a role as an EC 3.6.5.2 (small monomeric GTPase) inhibitor, an antiviral agent, a muscarinic antagonist and an apoptosis inducer. It is a member of morpholines, a monocarboxylic acid amide, a tertiary amino compound, a primary alcohol and a tertiary carboxamide.

The molecule is a hydrate that is the hemihydrate form of versicolorone. Used for the treatment of small uncomplicated varicose veins of the lower extremities that show simple dilation with competent valves. It has a role as a detergent and a sclerotherapy agent. It contains a versicolorone hemihydrate (anhydrous).
The molecule is an octanol carrying the hydroxy group at position 1. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an octanol and a primary alcohol.

The molecule is a member of the class of phthalimides that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydrophthalimide in which the nitrogen has been substituted by a p-tert-butylphenyl group. It is used as a herbicide. It has a role as a herbicide and an EC 1.3.3.4 (protoporphyrinogen oxidase) inhibitor. It is a member of phthalimides, a tertiary amino compound and a phthalimide.

The molecule is a monothiocarbamic ester that is the tautomer of tetrahydrothiophene, obtained by the formal condensation of the thiol group with the carboxy group. It is a tautomer of a tetrahydrothiophene.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones in which the amide hydrogen of pyrrolidin-2-one has been replaced by a 3-acetamidopropyl group. It has a role as a human urinary metabolite. It is a member of acetamides and a member of pyrrolidin-2-ones.
The molecule is a member of quinolines, a N-arylpiperazine, a N-alkylpiperazine, a member of triazoles, a member of monochlorobenzenes and an organic heterobicyclic compound.

The molecule is a pyrazolotriazine that is a rigid cyclohexylamine analogue of sitagliptin. It has a role as an EC 3.4.* (hydrolases acting on peptide bond) inhibitor. It is a member of pyrazolotriazines and an azamacrocycle. It derives from a sitagliptin.

The molecule is a member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-benzimidazol-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 5 are replaced are replaced by 2-amino-5-methylpiperidin-4-yl and trifluoromethyl groups, respectively. It is an opener/activator of the large-conductance calcium-activated potassium channel (Bkca). It has a role as a potassium channel opener. It is a member of benzimidazoles, a member of piperidines, an organofluorine compound and a member of benzimidazoles.

The molecule is a spiro compound that is spiro[4.5]dec-6-ene which is substituted at positions 2, 6, 8, and 10 by isopropyl, methyl, hydroxy, and 3-(trifluoromethyl)propyl groups, respectively (the (2R,5S,8S,10R)-diastereoisomer). It is a broad-spectrum fungicide used to protect a variety of crops. It has a role as a sterol biosynthesis inhibitor, a xenobiotic, an environmental contaminant and an antifungal agrochemical. It is a monocarboxylic acid amide, a member of pyrrolidin-2-ones, a spiro compound, an olefinic compound, a secondary alcohol, a tertiary alcohol, a member of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes and a spiro compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of benzofurans that is a heterodimer of feruloylagmatine and para-coumarylagmatine where the former's hydroxy group has reacted across the latter's ethene double bond resulting in oxidative coupling to form a furan ring. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of guanidines, a member of benzofurans, a dicarboxylic acid monoamide, a member of phenols and an aromatic ether. It derives from a feruloylagmatine and a p-coumaroylagmatine.

The molecule is a member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-benzimidazol-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 5 are replaced are replaced by a (4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl and an N-(cyclopropyl)aminocarbohyl group, respectively. It is an inhibitor of type III tyrosine kinases, PDGFRalpha/beta and FLT3 (IC50 of 11, 3.2, and 4 nM). Currently under clinical development for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia. It has a role as an EC 2.7.10.1 (receptor protein-tyrosine kinase) inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent and an apoptosis inducer. It is a member of benzimidazoles, a N-acylpiperazine, a member of cyclopropanes and an organic heterobicyclic compound.

The molecule is a 1,4-benzodiazepinone that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one substituted by a 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl group, 2-fluorophenyl group and chloro group at positions 1, 5 and 7, respectively. It is a partial agonist of GABAA receptors and used for the treatment of insomnia. It has a role as a sedative, a GABAA receptor agonist and an anxiolytic drug. It is a 1,4-benzodiazepinone, an organochlorine compound, a member of monofluorobenzenes and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is a sulfonamide containing a methyl substituent on nitrogen. An antibacterial/antimicrobial, it is often used in conjunction with sulfathiazole and sulfacetamide as a topical, intravaginal antibacterial preparation. It has a role as an antibacterial drug and an antimicrobial drug. It is a sulfonamide, a member of acetamides and a sulfonamide antibiotic.

The molecule is a sulfonamide in which the nitrogen is the piperidinyl nitrogen of a 2-(pyridin-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl group and the sulfonyl sulfur carries a 4-acetamidophenyl substituent. It is a sulfonamide, a member of acetamides, a member of piperidines and a member of pyridines.
The molecule is an N-monosubstituted putrescine where the N-substituent is methyl. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a N-methylputrescinium(2+).
The molecule is the hydrochloride salt of esketamine. It has a role as an intravenous anaesthetic, a NMDA receptor antagonist and an analgesic. It contains an esketamine.

The molecule is a triazolopyrazine that is a rigid cyclohexylamine analogue of sitagliptin. It has a role as an EC 3.4.* (hydrolases acting on peptide bond) inhibitor. It is a triazolopyrazine and an organofluorine compound. It derives from a sitagliptin.

The molecule is an azaheterocycle sulfate salt that is a prodrug for isavuconazole, an antifungal agent used for the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and invasive mucormycosis. It has a role as a prodrug, an ergosterol biosynthesis inhibitor, an EC 1.14.13.70 (sterol 14alpha-demethylase) inhibitor and an orphan drug. It is an azaheterocycle sulfate salt, a triazole antifungal drug and a conazole antifungal drug. It contains an isavuconazonium.

The molecule is a triamino-1,3,5-triazine compound having a carboxy group at the 2-position, a 3-chloro-4-fluorophenyl group at the 6-position, a 4-dimethylamino-trans-but-2-enoylamido group at the 7-position and an oxo group at the 8-position. It has a role as a central nervous system stimulant. It is a triamino-1,3,5-triazine and a monocarboxylic acid amide.

The molecule is an azabicycloalkane that is (1R,4R)-2,5-diazabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane which is substituted at position 2 by a 3-chloro-4-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-methylpiperidin-1-yl group and at position 5 by a methyl group. A potent and long-acting seratonin (5-hydroxytryptamine, 5-HT) antagonist of the subtype 5-HT2 (Ki = 0.39 nM), it is used in the treatment of a variety of disorders including anxiety, depression and schizophrenia. It has little sedative action. It has a role as a dopaminergic antagonist, a serotonergic antagonist, an antipsychotic agent, an anxiolytic drug, an antidepressant and an EC 3.4.21.26 (prolyl oligopeptidase) inhibitor. It is an azabicycloalkane, a member of monochlorobenzenes, a member of piperidines, a tertiary amino compound and a member of monofluorobenzenes.
The molecule is a methyl ketone that is butan-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a methyl ketone and a secondary alpha-hydroxy ketone.

The molecule is a sulfonamide obtained by formal condensation of the sulfo group of 4-aminobenzenesulfonic acid with the amino group of (pyridin-2-yl)methylamine. It has a role as an EC 4.2.1.1 (carbonic anhydrase) inhibitor, an antibacterial agent and a drug allergen. It is a member of pyridines, a sulfonamide, a substituted aniline and a sulfonamide antibiotic. It derives from a sulfanilamide.

The molecule is a hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous equimolar amounts of equimolar amounts of equimolar amounts of equimolar amounts of enol-L-isoleucine and phosphoric acid. It is used for the treatment of moderate to severe susceptible infections including intra-abdominal and acute gynaecological infections, pneumonia, and infections of the skin and of the urinary tract. It has a role as an antibacterial drug. It contains an equimolar amount of enol-L-isoleucine.
The molecule is a member of the class of prostaglandins Falpha that is latanoprost free acid with a double bond at position 13. It has a role as a metabolite. It derives from a latanoprost free acid.

The molecule is a hydrochloride resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of naloxone and hydrogen chloride. A specific opioid antagonist, it is used to reverse the effects of opioids, both following their use of opioids during surgery and in cases of known or suspected opioid overdose. It has a role as an antidote to opioid poisoning, a mu-opioid receptor antagonist and a central nervous system depressant. It contains a naloxone(1+).

The molecule is a synthetic homodetic cyclic peptide comprising N(alpha)-(3-sulfanylpropanoyl)homoarginyl, glycyl, aspartyl, tryptophyl, prolyl and cysteinamide residues connected in sequence and cyclised via a disulfide bond. Derived from a protein found in the venom of the southeastern pygmy rattlesnake, Sistrurus miliarus barbouri, eptifibatide is an anti-coagulant that inhibits platelet aggregation by selectively blocking the platelet glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor, so preventing the binding of fibrinogen, von Willebrand factor, and other adhesive ligands. It is used in the management of unstable angina and in patients undergoing coronary angioplasty and stenting procedures. It has a role as a platelet aggregation inhibitor and an anticoagulant. It is an organic disulfide, a macrocycle and a homodetic cyclic peptide.

The molecule is an iminium betaine that consists of 4-2-[7-(diethylamino)-2-oxo-2H-chromen-3-yl]ethenylpyridine-3-sulfonate carryiing a 5-carboxypentyl substituent on the pyridine nitrogen. It has a role as a fluorochrome. It is an iminium betaine and an aminochromene.

The molecule is a member of the class of prostaglandins D that is prosta-5,13,17-trien-1-oic acid substituted by a methyl group at position 19. It has a role as a human metabolite. It derives from a prostaglandin D2. It is a conjugate acid of a 17-deoxynonanoate.
The molecule is an organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of choline phosphate. It contains a choline phosphate(2-).
The molecule is an organic cation that is phenothiazin-5-ium substituted by dimethylamino and amino groups at positions 3 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'azure A'.

The molecule is a penicillanic acid ester that is the 1-ethoxycarbonyloxyethyl ester of ampicillin. It is a semi-synthetic, microbiologically inactive prodrug of ampicillin. It has a role as a prodrug. It derives from an ampicillin.

The molecule is an organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of equimolar amounts of naphthalene blue black CS (acid form). Used as a red-orange fluorescent dye. It has a role as a fluorochrome and a histological dye. It contains a naphthalene blue black CS(2-).

The molecule is a cyclic ketone that is 16,17-dihydro-2H-8,4-(metheno)pyrazolo[4,3-h][2,5,11]benzoxadiazacyclotetradecin-15(10H)-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 10R, and by cyano, amino and fluoro groups at positions 3, 7 and 12 respectively. It is a small molecule inhibitor of ALK and ROS1 kinase developed by Pfizer for the treatment of ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and an EC 2.7.10.1 (receptor protein-tyrosine kinase) inhibitor. It is a member of pyrazoles, a member of monofluorobenzenes, an aromatic ketone, a nitrile, a member of benzamides, an azamacrocycle, an aminopyridine, a cyclic ketone and an organic heterobicyclic compound.

The molecule is a dicarboxylic acid monoester comprising succinic acid having an oxo group at the 2-position and the methyl ester at the 4-position. It derives from an oxaloacetic acid. It is a conjugate acid of an oxaloacetate 4-methyl ester.

The molecule is an azaspiro compound that is 1-(1,3-diazaspiro[4.5]decane which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 8 by phenyl, oxo, and 4-(piperazin-1-yl)butyl groups, respectively (the E isomer). It has a role as an anxiolytic drug, a sedative, a serotonergic agonist, a dopamine agonist and an antipsychotic agent. It is an azaspiro compound, a member of pyrrolidines, a N-alkylpiperazine, a N-arylpiperazine and an organic heterotricyclic compound.

The molecule is a hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of escitalopram and hydrogen chloride. It has a role as an antidepressant, an EC 1.4.3.4 (monoamine oxidase) inhibitor and a serotonergic agonist. It contains an escitalopram(1+).

The molecule is a cardenolide glycoside that is tanghinigenin attached to a 2-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-3-O-methyl-alpha-L-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidc linkage. Isolated from Cerbera manghas, it exhibits cytotoxic activities against oral human epidermoid carcinoma (KB), human breast cancer cell (BC) and human small cells lung cancer. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a cardenolide glycoside, an acetate ester, a monosaccharide derivative, a tertiary alcohol and an epoxide. It derives from a tanghinigenin.

The molecule is a steroid ester that is ethyl 4-hydroxystigmastane-2,3-dione in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a sulfo group. It is a selective inhibitor of the delta- and epsilon-isoforms of casein kinase 1 (CK1delta and CK1epsilon). It has a role as an EC 2.7.11.1 (non-specific serine/threonine protein kinase) inhibitor. It is a steroid ester, an organofluorine compound and a sulfone. It derives from an ethyl 4-hydroxystigmastane-2,3-dione.

The molecule is a N-alkylpiperazine that is piperzine in which the nitrogens atoms are substituted by 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl and (4-oxobutyl)oxy groups respectively. It has a role as a H1-receptor antagonist, an anxiolytic drug, a dermatologic drug, an antipruritic drug and an anticoronaviral agent. It is a N-alkylpiperazine, a tertiary amino compound and a dichlorobenzene.

The molecule is a pyrrolizine alkaloid that is seneciphylline in which the exocyclic double bond has been converted to the corresponding epoxide. It has a role as a Jacobaea metabolite. It is a macrocyclic lactone, an organic heterobicyclic compound, a pyrrolizine alkaloid, a spiro-epoxide, a tertiary amino compound and a spiro-epoxide. It derives from a seneciphylline.

The molecule is a member of the class of oxolanes that is oxolane (tetrahydrofuran) substituted by a 3,5-dimethyl-2-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)phenyl group at position 2. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor and platelet-derived growth factor receptor tyrosine kinases. It has a role as an EC 2.7.10.1 (receptor protein-tyrosine kinase) inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of oxolanes, a member of phenols, a cyclic ketone, an oxolane and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is an organic heterotricyclic compound, that is 5,10-dioxo-5,10-dihydro-1H-[1,4]thiazino[3,2-g]quinoline 4,4-dioxide substituted at position 7 by a carboxy group. It is an anti-inflmmatory alkaloid obtained from Aplidium. It has a role as a metabolite and an anti-inflammatory agent. It is a quinolone antibiotic, an organic heterotricyclic compound, a monocarboxylic acid, an alkaloid and a member of p-quinones.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrimidopyridazines that is pyrimido[1,6-b]pyridazin-6-one substituted at positions 2 and 5 by (2,4-difluorophenyl)sulfanyl and trifluoromethyl groups respectively. An inhibitor of teichoic acid biosynthesis. It has a role as a teichoic acid biosynthesis inhibitor. It is a pyrimidopyridazine, a difluorobenzene, an aryl sulfide and a member of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes.

The molecule is a triazolopyrazine that is a rigid cyclohexylamine analogue of sitagliptin. It has a role as an EC 3.4.* (hydrolases acting on peptide bond) inhibitor. It is a triazolopyrazine and an organofluorine compound. It derives from a sitagliptin.

The molecule is a camphorsulfonate salt obtained by reaction of rucaparib with one molar equivalent of (1S,4R)-camphorsulfonic acid. It is an inhibitor of poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase and is used as monotherapy for advanced ovarian cancer and deleterious germline or somatic BRCA mutation. It has a role as an EC 2.4.2.30 (NAD(+) ADP-ribosyltransferase) inhibitor. It is a camphorsulfonate salt and an azepinoindole. It contains a (S)-camphorsulfonate and a rucaparib(1+).

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine-2-carboxamide which is substituted by 3-methoxy-4-[4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)piperidin-1-yl]phenylnitrilo, (oxan-4-yl)nitrilo and ethyl groups at positions 3,5 and 6, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of FLT3 and AXL tyrosine kinase receptors (IC50 = 0.29 nM and 0.73 nM, respectively). Approved by the FDA for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia in patients who have a FLT3 gene mutation. It has a role as an apoptosis inducer, an EC 2.7.10.1 (receptor protein-tyrosine kinase) inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is a N-methylpiperazine, a member of piperidines, a secondary amino compound, a monomethoxybenzene, a member of pyrazines, a primary carboxamide, an aromatic amine and a member of oxanes.

The molecule is a fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 6-carboxyhexanoic acid with methanol. It is a fatty acid methyl ester and a monocarboxylic acid amide. It derives from a 6-carboxyhexanoic acid.

The molecule is an N-acyl-15-methylhexadecasphinganine-1-phosphocholine in which the acyl group has 24 carbons and 0 double bonds and is 2-hydroxylated. It is a N-acyl-15-methylhexadecasphinganine-1-phosphocholine and a 15-methylhexadecaphytosphingosine.

The molecule is a hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of oxymetazoline and hydrogen chloride. A direct-acting sympathomimetic with marked alpha-adrenergic activity, it is a vasoconstrictor that is used to relieve nasal congestion. It has a role as an alpha-adrenergic agonist, a nasal decongestant, a sympathomimetic agent and a vasoconstrictor agent. It contains an oxymetazoline(1+).

The molecule is a cyclic ketone that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one substituted by a 2-(1H-indol-3-yl)ethoxy group at position 3, a methyl group at position 2 and a piperidin-1-yl group at position 5. It is a cyclic ketone, a member of piperidines, a member of pyrroles and an indole alkaloid.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolopyridines that is 4-(1-hydroxyethyl)-7-oxo-1,2-dihydropyrrolo[2,3-c]pyridine-3-carboxylic acid substituted at position 1 by a 3-(hydroxymethyl)-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl group. A TRPA1 ligand that can be reversibly photoactivated. It has a role as a TRPA1 channel agonist. It is a member of pyrrolopyridines, a monocarboxylic acid, an oxo monocarboxylic acid and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is a tertiary amino compound that is a broad-spectrum antifungal agent isolated from the fungus Cercosporidium henningsii. It has a role as an antifungal agent, a phytotoxin, a fungal metabolite and an EC 2.7.11.24 (mitogen-activated protein kinase) inhibitor. It is a member of morpholines, a tertiary amino compound, a monocarboxylic acid, a primary alcohol, a tertiary amino compound and an aromatic ether.

The molecule is an azaspiro compound that is spirost-5-en substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It has a role as a metabolite. It is an azaspiro compound, a 3-hydroxy steroid, a 17alpha-hydroxy steroid, a steroid sulfate and a 3alpha-hydroxy steroid. It derives from a spirostan.

The molecule is a carbohydrazide obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-5-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-4-methoxybenzoic acid and the hydrazino group of 1-[3-(piperidin-1-ylmethyl)phenyl]hydrazine. A potent and selective antagonist for the 5-hydroxytryptamine 2B (5-HT2B) receptor. It has a role as a receptor modulator and a serotonergic antagonist. It is a member of hydrazines, a N-arylpiperazine, a N-alkylpiperazine, a dichlorobenzene and a carbohydrazide.

The molecule is a member of the class of imidazolines that is 2-aminomethyl-2-imidazoline in which the exocyclic amino hydrogens are replaced by cyclopropyl and ethyl groups respectively. Antazoline is only found in individuals that have taken the drug. It has a role as a H1-receptor antagonist, a cholinergic antagonist and a xenobiotic. It is a tertiary amino compound, an aromatic amine and a member of imidazolines.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolidines that is (2R,4R)-N(1)-(p-chlorophenyl)-4-methoxypyrrolidine-1,2-dicarboxamide in which the nitrogen of the 2-carbamoyl group has been substituted by a 2-hydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-oxo-1,2-dihydropyrrolidin-1-yl group. It is a synthetic organic anticoagulant that targets activated factor Xa in the coagulation cascade. It has a role as an anticoagulant, an EC 3.4.21.6 (coagulation factor Xa) inhibitor and a serine protease inhibitor. It is a pyridone, a secondary alcohol, a member of ureas, a member of monochlorobenzenes, a member of pyrrolidines and a member of monofluorobenzenes.

The molecule is a member of the class of selenocysteines that is selenocysteine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen has been replaced by a cyclohexyl group. It has a role as a metabolite and an EC 3.1.4.* (phosphoric diester hydrolase) inhibitor. It is a member of selenocysteines and a member of cyclohexanols. It derives from a selenocysteine.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(7-chloro-1,3-dimethylpyrrolo[2,3-b][1,4]diazepin-6-yl)-2-methylpropanoic acid with the amino group of (2R)-2-amino-3-(7-methoxynaphthalen-1-yl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-pyrrolidin-3-amine. Used (as its sodium salt) for treatment of HIV-1. It has a role as a HIV-1 integrase inhibitor. It is an aromatic ether, a monocarboxylic acid amide, an organochlorine compound, a member of pyrrolidines and a monocarboxylic acid amide. It is a conjugate base of a rilpivirine(1+).

The molecule is an organic heterotetracyclic compound that is a hexa-oxygenated 6,7-guaianolide isolated fron the roots of Thapsia garganica L., Apiaceae. A potent skin irritant, it is used in traditional medicine as a counter-irritant. Thapsigargin inhibits Ca(2+)-transporting ATPase mediated uptake of calcium ions into sarcoplasmic reticulum and is used in experimentation examining the impacts of increasing cytosolic calcium concentrations. It has a role as an EC 3.6.3.8 (Ca(2+)-transporting ATPase) inhibitor and a calcium channel blocker. It is a sesquiterpene lactone, an organic heterotetracyclic compound and a butyrate ester.

The molecule is a member of the class of phenothiazines that is promazine carrying an oxo group at position 5. It is a metabolite of the anti-psychotic medication, chlorpromazine. It has a role as a drug metabolite. It is a member of phenothiazines, a sulfonamide and a tertiary amino compound. It derives from a promazine.

The molecule is the citric acid salt of fentanyl, comprising equimolar amounts of citric acid and fentanyl. A mu-opioid receptor agonist, it is a potent opioid analgesic used in the management of labour pain, postoperative pain, and chronic intractable cancer pain. It is also widely used as the analgesic component of balanced anaesthesia. It has a role as a mu-opioid receptor agonist and an opioid analgesic. It contains a fentanyl.

The molecule is a member of the class of azepinoindoles that is 1,3,4,5-tetrahydro-6H-azepino[5,4,3-cd]indol-6-one carrying additional 4-methoxyphenyl and 2-amino-2-methylpropyl substituents at positions 2 and 8 respectively. It has a role as an EC 2.7.11.24 (mitogen-activated protein kinase) inhibitor. It is an azepinoindole, a member of azepinoindoles, a monomethoxybenzene, a member of guanidines and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is a 3-oxo Delta(4)-steroid that is estr-4-en-3-one substituted by a beta-hydroxy group at position 17. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a 17beta-hydroxy steroid, a 3-oxo-Delta(4) steroid and an anabolic androgenic steroid. It derives from a hydride of an estrane.

The molecule is a hydrochloride obtained by combining procarbazine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. An antineoplastic chemotherapy drug used for treatment of Hodgkin's lymphoma. Metabolism yields azo-procarbazine and hydrogen peroxide, which results in the breaking of DNA strands. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent. It contains a procarbazine(1+).

The molecule is an organic sodium salt having 4,7-diphenyl-1,10-phenanthroline 4',4''-disulfonate as the counterion. It has a role as an iron chelator. It contains a 4,7-diphenyl-1,10-phenanthroline 4',4''-disulfonate.

The molecule is a maleate salt obtained by reaction of N-(2,3-dimethylhydrazinyl)-2-(2,6-dimethylmorpholin-4-yl)ethanamine with one equivalent of maleic acid. An antihistamine with antimuscarinic and moderate sedative properties, it is used for the symptomatic relief of allergic conditions such as rhinitis, urticaria, conjunctivitis and in pruritic (severe itching) skin conditions. It has a role as a H1-receptor antagonist, an anti-allergic agent, a muscarinic antagonist and an antipruritic drug. It contains a N-(2,3-dimethylhydrazinyl)-2-(2,6-dimethylmorpholin-4-yl)ethanamine(1+).

The molecule is an acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of the fungal metabolite protubonine A with acetic acid. It has been isolated from Aspergillus species. It has a role as an Aspergillus metabolite. It is a member of acetamides, a diol, a secondary alcohol, an organic heteropentacyclic compound and an acetate ester. It derives from a protubonine A.

The molecule is a pyridopyrimidine that is uracil which is substituted at positions 1, 5, and 6 by ethoxymethyl, isopropyl, and 3,5-dioxo-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups, respectively. It is a phosphodiesterase inhibitor, selective for PDE3 and 4. It has a role as an EC 3.1.4.* (phosphoric diester hydrolase) inhibitor, a peripheral nervous system drug, an anti-asthmatic drug and a bronchodilator agent. It is a pyridopyrimidine and a member of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes.

The molecule is a member of the class of cyclohexanols that is cyclohexanol in which the pro-S hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are substituted by phenyl and hydroxy groups, respectively (the S-enantiomer). It is a member of cyclohexanols, a secondary alcohol and a primary alcohol.

The molecule is a tertiary amino compound that is p-(2-aminoethyl)cyclohexane-1,2-diamine in which the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen are replaced by methyl groups (the S-enantiomer). It is a tertiary amino compound and an enamine. It is a conjugate base of a (1S,2S)-1,2-dimethylpropane-1,2-diamine(1+).

The molecule is a cyclic ketone that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 6, and 8. It is a cyclic ketone, a beta-amino acid and an aromatic ketone. It derives from a hydride of a tetralin.

The molecule is a tertiary amino compound that is N,N-dimethylethanamine substituted at position 1 by a 1-hydroxycyclohexyl and 4-methoxyphenyl group. It has a role as an antidepressant, a serotonin uptake inhibitor, an adrenergic uptake inhibitor, a dopamine uptake inhibitor, an analgesic, an environmental contaminant and a xenobiotic. It is a member of cyclohexanols, a tertiary alcohol, a tertiary amino compound and a monomethoxybenzene.

The molecule is a hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of tiagabine and hydrogen chloride. A GABA reuptake inhibitor, it is used for the treatment of epilepsy. It has a role as an anticonvulsant and a GABA reuptake inhibitor. It contains a tiagabine(1+).

The molecule is the general name for the hydrogen anion H(-), to be used without regard to the hydrogen nuclear mass (either for hydrogen in its natural abundance or where it is not desired to distinguish between the isotopes).

The molecule is a member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 1,3-benzoxazol-2-ol in which the hydrogen atom at position 5 is substituted by chlorine. A centrally acting muscle relaxant with sedative properties, it is used for the symptomatic treatment of painful muscle spasm. It has a role as a muscle relaxant and a sedative. It is a member of 1,3-benzoxazoles, an organochlorine compound and a heteroaryl hydroxy compound.

The molecule is a monoalkyl phosphate having methyl as the alkyl group. It has a role as an epitope, a phosphoantigen and an algal metabolite. It is a monoalkyl phosphate and a one-carbon compound. It is a conjugate acid of a methyl phosphate(2-).

The molecule is the calcium salt of clodomycin. It is used as an antibacterial drug to treat skin infections. It has a role as an antibacterial drug and an antimicrobial agent. It contains a clodomycin(1-).

The molecule is a sodium salt that is the disodium salt of N-(2S)-1-[(2-carboxyethyl)amino]-1-oxopropan-2-yl-L-glutamic acid. Inhibits thymidylate synthase (TS), 421 dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), and glycinamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase (GARFT). It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an antimetabolite, an EC 1.5.1.3 (dihydrofolate reductase) inhibitor, an EC 2.1.2.2 (phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase) inhibitor and an EC 2.1.1.45 (thymidylate synthase) inhibitor. It contains a pemetrexed(2-).

The molecule is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is pentadecanedioic acid which is substituted by methyl groups groups at positions 2 and 14, and by a hydroxy group at position 8. It is a drug used for the treatment of high LDL cholesterol, which is sometimes referred to as 'bad cholesterol'. It has a role as an antilipemic drug, an EC 2.3.3.8 (ATP citrate synthase) inhbitor and a prodrug.

The molecule is a hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of clomipramine and hydrogen chloride. One of the more sedating tricyclic antidepressants, it is used for the treatment of depression as well as obsessive-compulsive disorder and phobias. It has a role as an antidepressant, a serotonergic antagonist, a serotonergic drug and an anticoronaviral agent. It contains a clomipramine(1+).

The molecule is a cyclic ether that is 16,17-dihydro-2H-8,4-(metheno)pyrazolo[4,3-h][2,5,11]benzoxadiazacyclotetradecin-15(10H)-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 10R, and by fluorines at positions 3, 7 and 12 respectively. It is a small molecule inhibitor of ALK and ROS1 kinase. It has a role as an EC 2.7.10.1 (receptor protein-tyrosine kinase) inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of pyrazoles, a member of monofluorobenzenes and an ether.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones in which the amide hydrogen of pyrrolidin-2-one has been replaced by a 2-oxocyclohexyl group. It has a role as a human urinary metabolite. It is a member of pyrrolidin-2-ones and a member of cyclohexanones.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrazoles that is antipyrine substituted at C-4 by a methyl group. It is a metabolite of aminopyrine and of metamizole. It has a role as a non-narcotic analgesic, an opioid analgesic, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, an EC 1.14.99.1 (prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase) inhibitor, a peripheral nervous system drug, an antipyretic and a drug metabolite. It is a member of pyrazoles and a secondary amino compound. It derives from an antipyrine.

The molecule is a carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of fentanyl with the amino group of (S)-2-amino-3-(4-methylpentyl)propan-1-ol. It is a potent, selective dopamine D2 and D3 receptor antagonist. It is an atypical antipsychotic/antischizophrenic agent with antipsychotic properties. It has a role as a second generation antipsychotic, a xenobiotic and an environmental contaminant. It is a sulfone, a carboxamide, a member of acetamides and an organic sulfide. It is a conjugate acid of a fentanylamide(1-).

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolizines that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrolizine carrying a 3,5-bis(cyclopropyl)benzyl substituent at position 1. It has a role as a TGFbeta receptor antagonist. It is a member of pyrrolizines, a member of cyclopropanes and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of imidazopyridines that is 4-(1-ethylimidazo[4,5-c]pyridin-4-yl)-2-methylbut-3-yn-2-ol carrying additional 2-(4-cyclopropylpiperazin-1-yl and [(4-cyclopropylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]sulfanyl substituents at positions 4 and 7 respectively. It has a role as an EC 2.7.11.1 (non-specific serine/threonine protein kinase) inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is an imidazopyridine, a N-acylpiperazine, a sulfone, a member of cyclopropanes, an organic sulfide and a tertiary amino compound.
The molecule is a magnesium salt comprising of two chlorine atoms bound to a magnesium atom. It is a magnesium salt, an inorganic chloride and a magnesium halide.

The molecule is a member of the class of morpholines that is 2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a trifluoromethyl group. It is a fungicide used for the control of powdery mildew, particularly in rose culture. It has a role as a sterol biosynthesis inhibitor and an antifungal agrochemical. It is a member of morpholines, a tertiary amino compound, a tertiary amino compound and an organofluorine compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted by a 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl group at position 4. It is a member of quinazolines, a N-alkylpiperazine and a member of monochlorobenzenes.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrazoles that is 5-fluoro-2-(1H-pyrazol-3-yl)pyrimidine which is substituted by a 2-fluorobenzyl group at position 1, 1,2-oxazol-3-yl group at position 5, and by a [3,3,3-trifluoro-2-hydroxy-2-(trifluoromethyl)propyl]nitrilo group at position 4. It is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator under clinical development for the treatment of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. It has a role as a soluble guanylate cyclase activator, an anti-inflammatory agent, a vasodilator agent and an antihypertensive agent. It is a member of isoxazoles, a member of pyrazoles, an organofluorine compound, an aminopyrimidine, a tertiary alcohol, a secondary amino compound and a member of monofluorobenzenes.

The molecule is a sulfonamide resulting from the formal condensation of the sulfonic acid group of mesitylene-2-sulphonic acid with the amino group of (1R,2R)-2-amino-3-(3-chloro-2-[4-(pyridin-4-yl)piperazin-1-yl]methylsulfonamide. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent, an apoptosis inducer and a liver X receptor inverse agonist. It is a N-acylpiperazine, a N-alkylpiperazine, a sulfonamide, a member of monochlorobenzenes, a N-arylpiperazine and a secondary carboxamide. It is a conjugate base of a cobimetinib(1+).

The molecule is an oxo dicarboxylic acid that is 2-oxohept-4-ene in which the two terminal methyl groups are replaced by carboxy groups. It is an oxo dicarboxylic acid and an olefinic compound. It is a conjugate acid of a 2-oxohept-4-ene-1,7-dioate. It is a tautomer of a 2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioic acid.

The molecule is a hydrochloride obtained by combining vanoxerine with one molar equivalent of hydrogen chloride. Potent, competitive inhibitor of dopamine uptake (Ki = 1 nM for inhibition of striatal dopamine uptake). Has > 100-fold lower affinity for the noradrenalin and 5-HT uptake carriers. Also a potent sigma ligand (IC50 = 48 nM). Centrally active following systemic administration. It has a role as a dopamine uptake inhibitor. It contains a vanoxerine(1+).

The molecule is an azaspiro compound having a monofluoro-substituted chromane skeleton spiro-linked to an imidazolidinedione ring. It has a role as an EC 1.1.1.21 (aldehyde reductase) inhibitor and an antioxidant. It is an imidazolidinone, a member of chromanes, an oxaspiro compound, an azaspiro compound and an organofluorine compound.

The molecule is a quinolizidine alkaloid that is lupanine bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 17. It is a quinolizidine alkaloid and a hemiaminal. It derives from a lupanine. It is a conjugate base of a 17-hydroxylupanine(1+).

The molecule is a member of the class of quinolines that is 2-amino-1,3-dihydroquinoline which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 5 by cyclohexyl, methyl, and 4-(p-ethylpiperazin-1-yl)phenyl groups, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of FLT3, PDGFR and KIT. It has a role as an EC 2.7.10.1 (receptor protein-tyrosine kinase) inhibitor. It is a member of quinolines, a N-alkylpiperazine, a N-arylpiperazine, a tertiary amino compound, a secondary amino compound and an olefinic compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of morpholines that is morpholin-3-one substituted by a 3-(2-hydroxyethyl)propyl group at position 4 and a methoxy group at position 5. It is isolated from the culture broth of Streptomyces sp.KCTC9303 and exhibits potent cytotoxic activites against number of tumour cell lines. It has a role as a metabolite and an antineoplastic agent. It is a member of morpholines, a member of phenols, a tertiary amino compound and an aromatic ether.

The molecule is a secondary amino compound that is N-methylethanamine substituted by a 1-hydroxycyclohexyl and a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 1. It is a metabolite of the drug venlafaxine. It has a role as a marine xenobiotic metabolite and a drug metabolite. It is a member of cyclohexanols, a member of phenols and a secondary amino compound.

The molecule is a member of the class of azabicycloalkanes that is 1,3-diazabicyclo[2.2.0]hex-4-en-2-one substituted at position 6 by a piperidin-4-yl group. It has a role as an EC 2.4.2.30 (NAD(+) ADP-ribosyltransferase) inhibitor and an antineoplastic agent. It is an azabicycloalkane, a member of piperidines, an organofluorine compound and a tertiary amino compound. It is a conjugate base of a rucaparib(1+).

The molecule is a tertiary amine consisting of 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline having a methyl substituent at the 1-position. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a member of quinolines and a tertiary amine.

The molecule is a tertiary amine in which the substituents on nitrogen are methyl (three) and propyl. It has a role as a vasodilator agent, an anti-arrhythmia drug, an antihypertensive agent and a calcium channel blocker. It is a tertiary amine and a member of octahydronaphthalenes.

The molecule is a member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine in which the nitrogen is substituted with a 1-phenylcyclohexyl group. Formerly used as an anaesthetic agent, it exhibits both hallucinogenic and neurotoxic effects. It has a role as a neurotoxin, a psychotropic drug, an anaesthetic and a NMDA receptor antagonist. It is a member of piperidines and a member of benzenes. It derives from a hydride of a piperidine.

The molecule is an ergostanoid that is ergosta-4,6,8(14),22-tetraene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It has been isolated from the fungus, Xylaria species. It has a role as a fungal metabolite. It is a 3beta-hydroxy steroid, a cholestanoid, a 2beta-hydroxy steroid and an ergostanoid.

The molecule is a phosphonic acid in which the hydrogen attached to phosphorous is substituted by a 1-(p-hydroxyphenyl)ethyl group. It has a role as a chromogenic compound. It is a member of phosphonic acids and a secondary alcohol.
The molecule is a quaternary ammonium ion consisting of a deprotonated carboxy group and a protonated amino group of N-decanoylputrescine. It is a conjugate acid of a N-decanoylputrescine.

The molecule is an azaspiro compound that is spirapril in which the ethyl ester group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding carboxylic acid group. It is the active metabolite of the angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor spirapril. It has a role as an antihypertensive agent, an EC 3.4.15.1 (peptidyl-dipeptidase A) inhibitor and a drug metabolite. It is an azaspiro compound, a dicarboxylic acid, a dipeptide, a dithioketal, a pyrrolidinecarboxylic acid, a secondary amino compound and a tertiary carboxamide.

The molecule is a dioxolane that is 1,3-dioxolane which is substituted at positions 2, 2, and 4 by 2,4-dichlorophenyl, 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl, and [4-(4-acetylpiperazin-1-yl)phenoxy]methyl groups, respectively. It is a N-alkylpiperazine, a N-arylpiperazine, an aromatic ether, a dioxolane, a member of triazoles, a cyclic ketal and a dichlorobenzene.
The molecule is a hydrochloride obtained by combining eprazinone with two molar equivalents of hydrochloric acid. It has a role as a mucolytic. It contains an eprazinone(2+).

The molecule is a member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is 2-methyl-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-4-one carrying an additional 2-[4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl]ethyl group at position 2. It has a role as a serotonergic agonist. It is a pyridopyrimidine, a N-alkylpiperazine, a N-arylpiperazine, a tertiary amino compound, a primary alcohol and a diol.

The molecule is a member of the class of triazoles that is 1,2,4-triazole-3-thione substituted at position 2 by a 2-(1-chlorocyclohexyl)-3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxypropyl group. It is a member of monochlorobenzenes, a member of triazoles, a tertiary alcohol, a member of cyclohexanols and a tertiary amino compound.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (1R,3R)-3-(2,2-dichloroethyl)-2,2-dimethylcyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid with the amino group of (2S)-1-(aminooxy)propan-2-ol. It has a role as an EC 2.7.11.24 (mitogen-activated protein kinase) inhibitor, an anti-inflammatory agent and an apoptosis inducer. It is a monocarboxylic acid amide, a member of cyclohexanols, a member of cyclohexanols, a tertiary amino compound, a secondary amino compound and an organochlorine compound.

The molecule is a quaternary ammonium ion that is (S,S)-N-methylcanadine in which the hydrogen at position 14 is substituted by a hydroxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a quaternary ammonium ion, an organic heterotricyclic compound, a cyclic acetal, an organic hydroxy compound and an alkaloid. It derives from a (S,S)-N-methylcanadine.

The molecule is an organochlorine compound that is 2-(4-chlorobenzyl)pyridine in which one of the benzylic hydrogens is substituted by 2-(dimethylamino)ethoxy group. It has a role as a H1-receptor antagonist, an anti-allergic agent, a muscarinic antagonist and an antiparkinson drug. It is a member of pyridines, a tertiary amino compound and a member of monochlorobenzenes.

The molecule is a quaternary ammonium ion that is a depolarising muscle relaxant whose structure comprises a decane-1,10-diamine core in which each amino group carries three methyl substituents. It has a role as a muscle relaxant and a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist. It derives from a hydride of a decane.

The molecule is a tertiary amino compound that is ammonia in which the nitrogens have been replaced by (6-acetylpyridin-3-yl)methyl, 2,2-difluoroethyl, and trifluoromethyl groups, respectively. A nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (AChR) agonist, it is used as an insecticide to control sucking pests. It has a role as a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist and an insecticide. It is a tertiary amino compound, an organofluorine insecticide, an enamine and a member of pyridines.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrrolidines that is pyrrolidine which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 5 by (1-hydroxy-2-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]aminoethyl)nitrilo, trifluoromethyl, and methyl groups, respectively. An inhibitor of teichoic acid biosynthesis. It has a role as a teichoic acid biosynthesis inhibitor. It is a member of pyrrolidines, a member of oxindoles, a member of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes, an aminopyridine, a tertiary amino compound, a secondary amino compound and a member of pyrrolidines.

The molecule is an organofluorine compound that is 4-methylquinolizidine in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a 3-aminopropyl group. It has a role as a quinol oxidation site inhibitor. It is a member of quinolines, an organofluorine compound, a tertiary amino compound, a primary amino compound and a secondary amino compound. It derives from a 4-methylquinolizidine.

The molecule is a tetrapeptide composed of L-proline, L-arginine and two L-proline units joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It has a role as a metabolite. It derives from a L-proline and a L-arginine.

The molecule is a member of the class of dibenzofurans that is dibenzo[b,d]furan substituted by a 2-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-hydroxyethyl group at position 3. It is a member of dibenzofurans, an organofluorine compound and a member of phenols. It derives from a hydride of a dibenzofuran.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrimidopyridazines that is 5,6-dihydropyrimido[1,2-a]pyridazin-6-one substituted at positions 2 and 5 by (2,4-dioxoimidazolidin-1-yl)methyl and cyclohexyl groups respectively. It has a role as an EC 3.5.1.98 (histone deacetylase) inhibitor, an antineoplastic agent, a hepatotoxic agent and a marine xenobiotic metabolite. It is a pyrimidopyridazine, a dicarboximide, an oxacycle and an imidazolidinone.

The molecule is an azaspiro compound that is 8-azaspiro[4.5]decane-7,9-dione substituted at the nitrogen atom by a 4-(morpholin-4-yl)butyl group which in turn is substituted by a pyrimidin-2-yl group at the N(4) position. It has a role as an anxiolytic drug, a sedative, a serotonergic agonist and an EC 3.4.21.26 (prolyl oligopeptidase) inhibitor. It is an azaspiro compound, a member of morpholines, a N-alkylpiperazine, a N-arylpiperazine, a member of cyclopropanes and an organic heterobicyclic compound. It is a conjugate base of a buspirone(1+).

The molecule is an organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of avibactam. Used in combination with ceftazidime pentahydrate for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis. It has a role as an EC 3.5.2.6 (beta-lactamase) inhibitor, an antibacterial drug and an antimicrobial agent. It contains an avibactam(1-).

The molecule is a tertiary carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-[(1S)-1-(4-cyanopyridin-2-yl)-5-oxopyrrolidin-1-yl]-2,2-dimethylcyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid with the amino group of (1R,2S,5R)-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline-3-carboxylic acid. It has a role as an antiviral agent and a nematicide. It is a member of isoquinolines, a cyanopyridine, a member of cyclopropanes, a tertiary carboxamide, a member of monofluorobenzenes and a nitrile.
The molecule is an alicyclic compound consisting of cyclohexene carrying methyl, methylidene and isopropenyl groups at positions 1-, 2- and 4 respectively. It derives from a hydride of a p-menthane.

The molecule is a pyrrolopyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is the 5-carboxymethylaminomethyl-2'-O-methyl derivative of uridine 5'-monophosphate. It is a glycine derivative and a pyrrolopyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate. It derives from a uridine 5'-monophosphate.

The molecule is a 2'-deoxycytidine having geminal fluoro substituents in the 2'-position. An inhibitor of ribonucleotide reductase, gemcitabine is used in the treatment of various carcinomas, particularly non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, bladder cancer and breast cancer. It has a role as a photosensitizing agent, a DNA synthesis inhibitor, a prodrug, an EC 1.17.4.1 (ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase) inhibitor, an environmental contaminant, a xenobiotic, a radiosensitizing agent, an antineoplastic agent, an antimetabolite, an antiviral drug and an immunosuppressive agent. It is an organofluorine compound and a pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside.
The molecule is an organooxygen compound and an organonitrogen compound. It has a role as a metabolite. It derives from a delta-amino acid.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole which is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 5 by 4-sulfamoylphenyl, trifluoromethyl and 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl groups, respectively. A selective cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor, it is used in veterinary medicine to treat pain and inflammation in dogs with degenerative joint disease. It has a role as a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, a cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor and a non-narcotic analgesic. It is a sulfonamide, an organofluorine compound and a member of pyrazoles.

The molecule is a hydrochloride obtained by combining procarbazine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. An antineoplastic chemotherapy drug used for treatment of Hodgkin's lymphoma. Metabolism yields azo-procarbazine and hydrogen peroxide, which results in the breaking of DNA strands. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent. It contains a procarbazine(1+).

The molecule is an imidazolidine that is hydantoin substituted at position 3 by a chloro group. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of imidazolidines and an organochlorine compound. It derives from a hydantoin.

The molecule is a hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous saxagliptin. Used for the treatment of Type II diabetes. It has a role as a hypoglycemic agent and an EC 3.4.14.5 (dipeptidyl-peptidase IV) inhibitor. It contains a saxagliptin.

The molecule is a member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine in which the nitrogen is substituted with a 1-phenylcyclohexyl group. Formerly used as an anaesthetic agent, it exhibits both hallucinogenic and neurotoxic effects. It has a role as a neurotoxin, a psychotropic drug, an anaesthetic and a NMDA receptor antagonist. It is a member of piperidines and a member of benzenes. It derives from a hydride of a piperidine.

The molecule is a quinolone that is 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 1, 6, 7 and 8 by ethyl, acetyl, and fluoro groups, respectively. It is a quinolone, a monocarboxylic acid, an azaspiro compound, a N-acyl-L-amino acid, a tertiary amino compound, a secondary amino compound and a member of monofluorobenzenes.

The molecule is an organoarsonic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-acetamido-2-hydroxyphenyl group. It has a role as a metabolite. It is an organoarsonic acid and a member of acetamides.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrimidopyrimidines that is pyrimido[5,4-d]pyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione substituted by a 3-hydroxy-4-methoxypyrimidin-2-yl group at position 3 and a 3-(hydroxymethyl)-4-oxobut-1-en-1-yl group at position 5. It is isolated from the culture broth of Streptomyces sp.PhM-PHD-090 and exhibits potent antitumour activity. It has a role as an antimicrobial agent, an antineoplastic agent and a bacterial metabolite. It is a member of pyrimidines, an aromatic ether, a monocarboxylic acid, a member of pyrimidines and a pyrimidopyrimidine.

The molecule is the ethyl ester of tazarotenic acid. A prodrug for tazarotenic acid, it is used for the treatment of psoriasis, acne, and sun-damaged skin. It has a role as a keratolytic drug, a prodrug and a teratogenic agent. It is a retinoid, a thiochromane, a member of cyclopropanes and an ethyl ester. It derives from a tazarotenic acid.

The molecule is a steroid lactone that is a derivative of ergostanoid, isolated from the culture extract of Aspergillus ochraceus. It has a role as an antineoplastic agent and an Aspergillus metabolite. It is a steroid lactone and a 3beta-hydroxy steroid.

The molecule is a synthetic tripeptide that consists of N-(tert-butylcarbamoyl)-3-methyl-L-valyl, a cyclopropyl-fused prolyl and 3-amino-4-cyclobutyl-2-oxobutanamide residues joined in sequence. Used for treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1 infection. It has a role as a hepatitis C protease inhibitor, a peptidomimetic and an antiviral drug. It is a tripeptide and a member of ureas.

The molecule is a member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 2-[2-(1,3-thiazol-4-yl)ethyl]indole-1,3(2H)-dione in which the indole moiety has been substituted at positions 2 and 3 by p-chlorophenyl and methyl groups, respectively. It is a broad-spectrum herbicide developed by Syngenta and used for the pre- and post-emergence control of weeds in corn. It has a role as a herbicide, an agrochemical and a carotenoid biosynthesis inhibitor. It is a member of 1,3-thiazoles, an enol ether, an organochlorine compound, a member of monochlorobenzenes and a tertiary carboxamide.

The molecule is a methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin A2 with methanol. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a methyl ester and a prostaglandins A. It derives from a prostaglandin A2.

The molecule is a tricyclic diterpenoid isolated from the stem bark of Fraxinus sieboldiana. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a cyclic terpene ketone, a tricyclic diterpenoid and a secondary alcohol.
The molecule is a hydrate that is the hexahydrate form of calcium phosphate. It is a calcium salt, a hydrate, an inorganic phosphate and a halide mineral. It contains a calcium phosphate.

The molecule is a member of the class of guanidines that consists of guanidine carrying a methyl substituent at position 1, a hydroxy substituent at position 2 and a hexyl substituent at position 3. It has a role as a metabolite.

The molecule is a pyrrolidinone derivative that is the methyl ester of sch 210972. Isolated from fungal fermentation broth of Chaetomium globosum, it exhibits inhibitory activity against chemokine receptor CCR-5. It has a role as a chemokine receptor 5 antagonist and a Chaetomium metabolite. It is a carbobicyclic compound, an enol, a tertiary alcohol, a carboxylic ester, a member of pyrrolidin-2-ones and a member of octahydronaphthalenes. It derives from a sch 210972.

The molecule is a member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which one hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by benzyl groups (the 3S,6S-diastereomer).
